name: Vaporview
description: Waveform viewer for VCD, FST, and GHW files. A port of the VS Code extension vaporview.

cover.alt: Vaporview: View VCD, FST, and GHW waveforms right in Orca's editor.

screenshots.alt: The Vaporview plugin in Orca: a waveform in an editor tab, with the waveform list and the netlist tree in the sidebar
screenshots.caption: A waveform with the netlist tree

settings.title: Netlist Icons
settings.description: The icons of the items in the netlist tree and in the search results. "Orca" uses the icon set of Orca in one color. "Vaporview" uses the icons and colors of vaporview in VS Code.

settings.title: Scrolling Mode
settings.description: Scrolling mode for the waveform viewer. Options: 'mouse' (default), 'touch'.

settings.title: Touchpad Pinch Sensitivity
settings.description: Touchpad pinch zoom sensitivity - Higher values Zoom faster.

settings.title: Sort Netlist
settings.description: Alphabetically sort scopes, parameters, and variables in the netlist view

settings.title: Remove Glitch Transitions
settings.description: Remove glitch transitions (multiple value changes in a single time step) in the waveform viewer. Files must be reloaded for this setting to take effect.

settings.title: Default Time Unit
settings.description: When opeining a new wavefom dump file, users can specify a default time unit to convert to.

settings.title: Default Auto Reload
settings.description: Recommended: false (unchecked) - default state for the 'Auto Reload' checkbox in the control bar. When enabled, files opened will have auto reload enabled by default.

settings.title: Show Ruler Lines
settings.description: Vertical ruler lines in the waveform viewer.

settings.title: Fill Multi Bit Values
settings.description: Multi-bit renderer style - If checked, fills the value box with color. If unchecked, only the outline is drawn.

settings.title: Multi Bit Fixed Height
settings.description: Bit vector renderer style - If checked, multi-bit signals are drawn with a fixed height. If unchecked, short transitions are drawn with a smaller height.

settings.title: Default Single Bit Color
settings.description: Default waveform color for single bit signals.

settings.title: Default Multi Bit Color
settings.description: Default waveform color for multi bit signals.

settings.title: Default Param Color
settings.description: Default waveform color for parameters.

settings.title: Default String Color
settings.description: Default waveform color for strings.

settings.title: Default Enum Color
settings.description: Default waveform color for enums.

settings.title: Default Custom Signal Color
settings.description: Default waveform color for custom signals.

settings.title: Custom Color5
settings.description: Fallback color for Color 5, must be a valid color name.

settings.title: Custom Color6
settings.description: Fallback color for Color 6, must be a valid color name.

settings.title: Custom Color7
settings.description: Fallback color for Color 7, must be a valid color name.

settings.title: Custom Color8
settings.description: Fallback color for Color 8, must be a valid color name.

settings.title: Enable Animations
settings.description: Enable animations for the waveform viewer.

settings.title: Animation Duration
settings.description: Animation duration in milliseconds.

settings.title: Use Glow
settings.description: Enable CRT glow effect for the waveform viewer. This is aesthetic only and may impact performance.

settings.title: Override Device Pixel Ratio
settings.description: Recommended: false (unchecked) - Override the device pixel ratio for the waveform viewer. This can be used to improve performance on high-DPI displays, or correct for incorrect device pixel ratio detection.

settings.title: User Pixel Ratio
settings.description: Device pixel ratio for the waveform viewer. This is only used if 'Override Device Pixel Ratio' is enabled.

settings.title: Disable Analog Renderer Optimizations
settings.description: Recommended: false (unchecked) - Disable optimizations for the analog renderer. This may reduce rendering performance.
